title: Portainer Community Edition and Business Edition 2.39.0 before 2.45.1 contain a server-side request forgery…
description: Portainer Community Edition and Business Edition versions from 2.39.0 up to but not including 2.45.1 contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. This flaw arises because user-supplied URLs are only syntax-checked without validating the resolved addresses. Authenticated users can exploit this to make the server send requests to internal, loopback, or cloud metadata addresses, potentially probing ports and reading responses.
